final: WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS member_amount FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT member_amount, 1.0 * member_amount / (SELECT SUM(member_amount) FROM member_totals) AS share FROM member_totals), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.member_amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value
